The shape of this fixture was cut from a captured run: a split review_fanout with one native seat (dispatch.js) and a sidecar fold, closed by `sidecar_fanout.py --review-close --workflow-dir`. All identities, paths, file names and quoted text are neutral values. host_result.json is the Workflow host result (no `verification`), journal.jsonl its journal, review.json, claims.json and post_check.json the close's out-dir files. The close recorded 5 verified, 0 unverified; a later hand edit applied the 4 FIX findings, and edited_after_close.json lists the cited files whose quotes that edit removed (the audit's quote-absent rows). The test plants the pre-edit and live bytes from the evidence quotes.
